attempted_claim: Let X_sm be a very general smooth ordinary complex Gushel-Mukai fourfold with Lagrangian A and let X_nod be a one-nodal ordinary Gushel-Mukai fourfold whose smoothing has Lagrangian A' specializing to A, so the vanishing cohomology and Mukai lattice of a categorical resolution Ku_res(X_nod) carry a limit K3-type Hodge structure specializing to that of Ku(X_sm) with identified Hochschild homology HH_*. Decide by proof or disproof whether Ku_res(X_nod), realized via the quadric-fibration Clifford-algebra resolution, is exact-equivalent by a Fourier-Mukai type kernel to Ku(X_sm) compatibly with the specialization identification of HH_* and a Hodge isometry of Mukai lattices. A complete answer is either such a compatible equivalence with HH and limit-Hodge verification, or a proof that Hochschild cohomology, Serre-invariant stability data, or the limit Hodge structure obstructs any such equivalence.
decisive_failure: No complete proof or disproof of the nodal-resolution versus smooth Kuznetsov equivalence was obtained: the Clifford kernel construction, Hochschild comparison, limit-Hodge monodromy analysis, and geometric-versus-nongeometric recovery test all blocked as documented in output/target_exit.json and output/WORKLOG.md. This report claims no original result and submits no emergent finding.
